key.name: hotkey-zoom
key.description: Zoom the monitor under the cursor in or out.

key.name: hotkey-follow
key.description: While zoomed, pause or resume panning with the cursor.

key.name: zoom-level
key.description: Magnification factor applied to the zoomed monitor.

key.name: zoom-duration-ms
key.description: Duration of the zoom in and zoom out animation, in milliseconds.

key.name: follow-smoothing
key.description: How quickly the view catches up with the cursor. 1.0 keeps the content under the cursor exactly in sync (clicks land where you see them). Lower values glide more but the view lags behind the pointer.

key.name: follow-default-on
key.summary: Follow the cursor when zooming in
key.description: Whether the view starts out following the cursor each time you zoom in.

key.name: software-cursor
key.summary: Software cursor while the view is fixed
key.description: While zoomed with follow off, hide the system cursor and draw one at the magnified position, so clicks, dragging and highlighting land on what you see. Turn off if the pointer misbehaves.

key.name: follow-cursor
key.description: Whether to draw our own cursor while the view follows the pointer. 'auto' does so on GNOME 49 and older, where the system cursor can disappear while zoomed, and uses the system cursor on GNOME 50 and newer.
